summary:
Summary of completed enhancements:
1. Permanent Master Key Deletion: eliminated all auto-reseed and fallback occurrences of omni_live_master_default_2026.
2. Manage Accounts for Existing Keys: added '+ Add / Manage Accounts' button and modal on every key card with persistence to worker.js and Supabase.
3. Single-Account Write Routing & Smart Read Tracking: writes are routed to exactly one target account, indexed in data_routing_log, and reads return stored_in_account metadata.
